name: BACH_0356
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (96%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1], model agreement, and neighbors support InSitu; simulated frozen-section margins show tumor [F11].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 96%, Invasive 3%, Benign 1%, Normal 0% | Strong InSitu; test ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | InSitu (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Reliable, atypical OOD; error AUROC 0.70 |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu (0.78–0.83 similarity) [F5] | All nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 5, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-1.14 contribution) opposes invasion; 12/20 AI spot-checked [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.74 contribution) from an unreliable 0/20 concept [F3] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.58 contribution) pushes toward invasion; 20/20 spot-checked [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.42 contribution) from an unreliable 3/20 concept · Unreliable
- **Nuclear size and shape variation** (regions 4, 9, 10) · context · Size variation 100th percentile [F8], shape 90th [F9], small nuclei [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); case leans on unreliable normal_lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal stromal invasion exists in high-risk regions 10 (84% risk), 9 (70%), or 4 (57%, top invasion score).
- Weak duct-confinement scoring (12/20 spot check) misses invasion resembling nearest invasive case BACH_0391 (0.72 similarity).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 10, 9, 4**: Check highest-risk regions (84%, 70%, 57% risk) for stromal invasion and dead cells [F10].
2. **Regions 0, 5, 10**: Confirm atypical cells remain confined within ducts and check all four surgical margins.
3. **Regions 7, 8, 11**: Check whether unreliable necrosis scores (3/20 spot check) reflect true comedonecrosis or artifact.

found: The CONCH–MUSK row names InSitu, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
OOD percentile 1 means this image is farther from the calibration images than 100% of them (atypical), not 'typical'.
